paragraphs: R. Marinos bar Oshaya, Jerusalem Talmud, Keitzad Mevarekhin, mishnah 5. Bereshit Rabbah, section 64, has 'son of R. Yehoshua,' but Yalkut, Yirmeyah§20 and Iyov§3, has Oshaya; thus Yehoshua is a scribal error.
